verdict.rationale: Gumloop offers two selectable flavors of API key, and team (workspace) keys are scoped to a single team, so there is a coarse, product-native credential boundary. However, the docs say both auth methods grant the same permissions on every endpoint, and nothing shows per-agent or least-privilege permission scoping. missing for 10: per-agent credential issuance, fine-grained permission or endpoint scopes, read-only or limited-action keys, documented key rotation/expiry for agents, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Team (workspace) API keys are scoped to a single team.
Gumloop offers two flavors of API key, selectable when you generate one.
Generate one from the Connectors page, then pass it as a bearer token.
